summary: FDX stopped out (−9.4%) on FY2027 guidance miss after a Q4 beat; SPCX stopped out (−15.6%) at $156.11 as KOSPI 'Black Tuesday' contagion erased post-IPO gains and triggered both prose invalidation conditions. Three new ideas added: long MU conditional on tonight's Q3 beat-and-raise (consensus $35.75B rev, 17% options move priced), long TSM on AI wafer monopoly re-entry at $443 (KOSPI rout, not fundamental), and short HYG as BofA's 3-hike framework reprices credit spreads ahead of June 25 PCE. STEP ASIDE regime holds at medium conviction: four of six indicators breached; NVDA Annual Meeting at noon ET and Micron Q3 after close are today's two designated clearing catalysts.

closed_today.note: FDX Q4 FY2026 beat on EPS ($6.31 vs $5.92 est.) and revenue ($25.0B vs $24.0B), but FY2027 guidance disappointed sharply: EPS $16.90–18.10 vs ~$20 analyst expectations, citing stranded costs from the Freight spin-off and a new pilot contract. Stock dropped 6.2% AH June 23 to $297.70, triggering the explicit invalidation condition: 'after-hours FDX falls more than 5% on the initial print.' June 24 pre-market confirmed at $295.70, below the $308 stop. Return from $326.20 creation price.

SPCX fell to $156.11 on June 23 close, below the $165 daily-close stop, as the KOSPI 'Black Tuesday' contagion (−9.99% KOSPI, largest single-day drop in Korean market history) erased most of SPCX's post-IPO gains. The stock touched below its $135 IPO price intraday before recovering to $156.11. Both prose invalidation conditions simultaneously triggered: DXY closed at 101.38 (above 101 threshold) AND SPX closed at 7,365 (below 7,460). June 24 range $147.11–$165.50 confirms the stop zone. Return from $185.0 creation price.
